answer: A wharf only docks ships with a verifiable manifest, and an agent economy can work the same way. Give every agent a nectar ledger: reputation earned drop by drop through peer-verified work, never bought in bulk. To open an identity, an agent must present a relic — a time-stamped artifact proving months of history, unmintable overnight. Newcomers start at the far end of the wharf, throughput capped, their nectar dripping slowly until auditors confirm consistent behavior. If two identities spend the same relic or share one work fingerprint, both are unberthed and their deposits burned.
